sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check white pixels near the player
seg = current_frame.segmentation
white_near = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1]
print(f"White pixels near player:")
for n in white_near:
    b = n['boundary']
    r, c = b[0]
    if r >= 30 and r <= 40 and c >= 0 and c <= 20:
        print(f"  White at ({r}, {c})")

# Check player boundary
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        print(f"\nPlayer boundary: {n['boundary']}")
        # Check if player overlaps with any white pixel
        player_cells = [tuple(p) for p in n['boundary']]
        for w in white_near:
            w_cell = tuple(w['boundary'][0])
            if w_cell in player_cells:
                print(f"  Player overlaps with white at {w_cell}")

# Try pressing LEFT to see if player collects white pixel
print("\nPressing LEFT once...")
action(['LEFT'], intent='solve')

# Check if white pixel was collected
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
white_near2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1]
near_count = len([n for n in white_near2 if n['boundary'][0][0] >= 30 and n['boundary'][0][0] <= 40 and n['boundary'][0][1] >= 0 and n['boundary'][0][1] <= 20])
print(f"White pixels near after LEFT: {near_count}")

for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        print(f"Player boundary after: {n['boundary']}")
        break

# Check bar
def get_bar(seg):
    red = 0
    green = 0
    gray = 0
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if any(p[0] < 3 for p in n['boundary']):
            b = n['boundary']
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            if n['color'] == 'R':
                red += 1
            elif n['color'] == 'N':
                green = max(cols) - min(cols) + 1
            elif n['color'] == 'G':
                gray = max(cols) - min(cols) + 1
    return red, green, gray

print(f"Bar after: {get_bar(seg2)}")
print(f"gameplay_changed: {last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
print(f"board_changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
